items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] August Ranois, I bet you can tell us the name of the man in this band... [INTERVIEWEE] I think August is his name.

ctx.x: I could glue it to another piece. That's why I'll tell you.
August Ranois, I bet you can tell us the name of the man in this band. Huh? I bet you August can tell us the name of the band.
I think August is his name. He's this man soon of all. Yeah well August can tell you the name of the band. I think you can take that off. Just pull it off. Now look.
